title: Portuguese Wrap
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Portuguese-inspired wrap recipe, featuring warm and crispy chicken, wrapped in a flavorful portuguese-style wrap, topped with fresh herbal notes and crispy wilted greens.

ingredients.name: Portuguese-style wrap
ingredients.notes: Found in most international grocery stores

ingredients.name: Fresh herbs (such as parsley or cilantro)
Wilted greens (such as spinach or kale)

instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper. Place on a baking sheet and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the wilted greens and cook until crispy, about 3-4 minutes.
Warm the Portuguese-style wrap according to package instructions.
To assemble the wrap, place a portion of the cooked chicken, wilted greens, and fresh herbs onto the center of the wrap.
Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
